long_biography.plain_text:
FGG Finngas gives Frank Ernst Friedrich Auer responsibility for a specialised cross-border storage operation. The company's Hamina terminal handles liquefied gases arriving by rail or sea, with shore tanks and a dedicated jetty supporting loading, unloading and storage. Auer serves as managing director of the German company and authorised representative of its Finnish branch.

His corporate work extends beyond terminal operations. Auer also manages businesses connected to mineral-oil and raw-material distribution, while Amarto AG places him in a different field. He joined the Basel company's board in 2022 and became chairman in 2026. Amarto's registered purpose centres on trading art, antiques and related rights, with Auer holding individual signing authority.
